Taxes and fees at Panama City Panama hotels

At the 14 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 10% ($22 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 9% at Riande Urban Hotel to 11% at Aloft by Marriott Panama. At 4 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
